def strip_deps(w):
 out=[];i=0
 while i<len(w):
  if w[i]in ['-MD','-MMD']:i+=1
  elif w[i]in ['-MT','-MF','-MQ']:i+=2
  else:out.append(w[i]);i+=1
 return out
